title: spec(ownership-queue-service): the onFailedRead docblock still says the registered service does not honour 'refuse' yet
body:
domain:server#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZMkHvuDeVYgTD73qF

Filing gate: ② a published description that a behaviour change makes false. Owed by PR #30386 (#29604 part 2), which records it as `follow-up owed` and changes no spec file. Filed by `domain:server` seat 4 for the spec lane. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3. ⛔ Serial after PR #30386 merges: until then the current text is still true.

## What turns false after PR #30386

`packages/spec/src/contracts/ownership-queue-service.ts` (added by PR #30318, #30251):

1. `OwnershipQueueFailedReadAnswer`: "the registered one … honours `'refuse'` from #29604's code half on, so until then a caller passing `'refuse'` still gets `'nobody'`". After PR #30386 the registered service honours it, so the "until then" clause drops.
2. Same docblock: "whether that posture moves is #29604's code half to decide". PR #30386 decided it: the posture does not move (admission consumers D3, D4, D5 keep "nobody"). State the decision.
3. `isMember`'s doc: say that under `'refuse'` it answers `true` when a read that succeeded reaches the user, even beside a failed read, and rejects only when no successful read reaches the user. PR #30386 implements this; the contract fixes only when `false` may be answered.

## Ask

Rewrite the three sentences to match. Wording only: `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` expected.

Reader who acts: `domain:spec`, `packages/spec/src/contracts/ownership-queue-service.ts`.

Dedupe: `onFailedRead until then`, `ownership-queue-service refuse docblock`. **New.**
